_readme: Hero section. `headline` is the page's h1. `statusLine` sits under it; its tones map to theme color tokens: default | bright | heading | prose | muted | subtle | faint | dim | ghost | accent. The index under the hero lists every project whose tier is "flagship" in projects.json, each with its `status` and the host of its demo link, and each row opens that project's case study. `portrait` is the big photo beside the headline: put originals (png or jpg; a transparent 1:1 cut-out works best) in assets/portrait and run `npm run images`, which writes resized WebP copies to public/portrait. They show in file-name order, one more per click. Restart the server after adding photos. The theme's `media.portraitTint` tones them blue; hovering shows the true color.
